name: BIRD-SQL
intro: BIRD-SQL是一个大规模、跨领域的文本到SQL基准测试，包含超过12,751个文本-SQL对和95个数据库，覆盖37个专业领域。该基准测试的重点是处理真实世界中的挑战，例如不干净的数据库内容、需要外部知识才能回答的自然语言问题，以及在大规模数据库中SQL查询的效率。
org: The University of Hong Kong, DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group, Tsinghua University, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 双专家独立标注, 双执行一致性校验, 专家仲裁
metric: Execution Accuracy (EX), Valid Accuracy (VA), Reward-based Valid Efficiency Score (R-VES)
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
eval_feature: 跨领域, 外部知识证据, 真实脏数据, 查询执行效率 (VES)
build_method_en: Dual-expert annotation, Double-check execution matching, Expert arbitration
eval_feature_en: Cross-domain, External Knowledge Evidence, Database Scale, Efficiency (VES)
intro_en: BIRD-SQL is a large-scale, cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark containing over 12,751 text-SQL pairs and 95 databases across 37 professional fields. It focuses on real-world challenges such as noisy database content, natural language questions requiring external knowledge, and the efficiency of SQL queries on large-scale databases.
metric_en: Execution Accuracy (EX), Valid Accuracy (VA), Reward-based Valid Efficiency Score (R-VES)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with BIRD-SQL arXiv:2305.03111v3 (NeurIPS 2023) Sections 3.2-3.4 and Appendix; official bird-bench/BIRD repository commit snapshot dec31ae335d7a5168ee17d5cc40c105e0da66d4e. BIRD-SQL evaluates cross-domain text-to-SQL performance and execution efficiency across 95 databases (33.4GB) spanning 37 domains. Track A details ER schema profiling, dual-expert independent SQL authoring with external knowledge evidence, dual-execution equivalence decision gate branching to either direct retention or expert adjudication to pick the most efficient query, yielding 12,751 validated pairs partitioned into 69 train (9,428), 11 dev (1,534), and 15 held-out test (1,789) databases. Track B models schema and evidence prompt assembly, model SQL generation, SQLite sandbox execution, order-agnostic result set equivalence checking, query execution time measurement, and official Execution Accuracy (EX), Valid Accuracy (VA), and Reward-based Valid Efficiency Score (R-VES) reporting.
